digest.component_or_area: read-path concurrency and reconverge lock handling
propositions: Multiple read CLI surfaces (show, list, search, ready) can return empty/truncated stdout with exit 0 when reconverge lock times out during concurrent background write-push bursts, causing loss of output integrity.
The existing ed2b fix (2-second reconverge lock timeout) applies only to show; other surfaces sharing the same ensure_fresh path lack coverage and regress silently.

A parameterized property test covering all read surfaces must verify: exit 0 implies stdout parses as the surface's documented JSON shape (valid-empty [] passes; truncated-empty fails); nonzero exits are acceptable.

The throttle marker /tmp/.ticket-sync-<md5(tracker)> must be cleared before each read invocation to ensure every surface exercises the reconverge path rather than short-circuiting to the local snapshot.
Reverting _RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT from 2 back to 15 seconds reproduces the stall/truncation bug under write-burst contention; the fix is confirmed by green test under the corrected timeout.
